title: Zuck Announces Meta's NEW AI Model... it's 🔥 up...

comments.author: @WesRoth
comments.text:
Two quick notes about the video:
1) I'm testing something in the thumbnail image (some of you already guessed it). will post the results later.

2) a lot of people saying that Meta is the best video generator... Maybe. I think it's very good. Currently I think Runway gen-3 is slightly better, but that's subjective. Once we can fully test it out, I'm happy to do a side by side comparison and then we can crown the king.

with that said, I'm strictly talking about the basic 'text to video'.  The other 3 functionalities Meta added (personalized video, specific edits and soundtracks) those are absolutely incredible.  I'm betting Meta will take the undisputed #1 spot with some minor improvements, probably very soon.

UPDATE: just posted a poll on Meta's new model. vote here:

In the very near future, we will no longer consider generative AI that cannot create a real movie in minutes.

comments.author: @TheBann90
comments.text:
I hope the editing is good at prompt adherence. Usually I feel when editing using firefly or some flux editor that inpainting in 4 out of 5 cases creates more problems than it solves. So it can take half an hour to get a good inpainting output 😢

Either way, even if quality is not up to snuff at text to video, maybe it will be better at image to video.

And even if even image to video is not as great as Kling 1.5 is now, or the new Seaweed model from Bytedance, the other techicalities of this model truly seem groundbreaking. The special sound effects might be my favourite since it adds so much immersion. Not to mention the uploading of your own image. I wonder how far this can be taken though. Can I edit myself? Like make me even more buffed like Arnold or Stallone? Or make me younger or older like that other website I cant recall the name of offered? Or can I make a person with Flux or Mystic and then upload that image? And can I then for example change the ethnicity of that artificial person? And is just 1 photo enough? Is it enough if the photo is at an angle or from the side? And will I be able to use the same character in multiple scenes in a user friendly way?

I have many questions, but if all this pans out in the best way, it could truly be Meta's best thing so far in AI.

I also pray that it will understand prompts better when I tell the camera where to move in a 3d space. Kling is awfull at this, and Runway isn't much better. Motion brush also has its flaws.

PS: also don't forget it's got 16 seconds of 16 frames. More than Kling's 10 sec of 12 frames. (Sorry Runway, you are way behind Kling)
